# l3-scripts

The L3 scripts, validators and QA checks: reuse-first terminology and code-list lookup (`terminology-lookup.ts`), the IG DAK API sidecar generator (`ig-site-sidecars.ts`) and DAK metadata reader (`ig-dak-metadata.ts`), the IG bibliography citation checker (`check-ig-citations.ts`), and the DAK pre-export overlay (`dak-pre-export.sh`).

Part of [SMART Base](../../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `l3-scripts`, holding `code`.
